name: Bhushan Chemate
summary:
• Business Continuity Manager with 13+ years of experience in
business continuity management, disaster recovery, and DR
automation, with strong expertise in strategic planning, risk
management, crisis management, incident response and program
management aligned to business objectives.
• Led and supported BCM and DR exercises for clients across banking,
insurance, retail, telecom, automobile, and aviation sectors.
• Specialized in end-to-end Business Continuity Management, including
business impact analysis (BIA), risk analysis and management, crisis
and incident management, and BCM planning, implementation, and
testing.
• Experienced in planning and executing DR drills for scenarios such as
project DR, BAU DR, data center migrations, transition projects, and
BCM standardization/compliance initiatives; additionally supported
data center-level DR drills, major incidents, and DR automation using
the Kyndryl Recovery Orchestration tool.
